mask_b2 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)

# Correct baseline logic:
x_base1 = np.mean(x[mask_b1]) if np.any(mask_b1) else 1100
y_base1 = np.mean(y1[mask_b1]) if np.any(mask_b1) else 0
x_base2 = np.mean(x[mask_b2]) if np.any(mask_b2) else 1800
